title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Handling conditions for retained-fee cash return.

## Handling condition

For retained-fee cash return: Before paying a retain-one-fee support surplus refund, the customer must have personally filed the exact pending refund authorization for the original completed payment and its calculated amount.

For retained-fee cash return: This paid rate-error reconciliation applies to full-month, on-demand standard US East source service with approved negotiated support terms and reviewed US untaxed tax treatment. Support service records retain the already official compute export physical quantities for the exact source support invoice; they carry no financial posting. Other products confer no support discount. Recompute the same retain-one-fee surplus at payment handling time and require it to equal the customer-authorized amount.
